annotations.title: Open a hunting party (a pooled outcome bounty)

description: A HUNTING PARTY is a time-boxed, pooled bounty on Rokha: a brief, a MEASURED goal, a deadline and two pots. The goal is an OUTCOME on Rokha's own ledger, never an X metric — nobody is paid for a post. Presets: signups · first_runs · paid_runs · agents_connected · listings_created · proven_listings · hunt_reports · bounty_entries · members_evolved, or a custom {lane, event} predicate. Pots: the REWARD is USDC, escrowed before the party exists (goal met = whole pot; missed = pro-rata or nothing; split by attributed share, per-member cap); the WORK pot is FUEL from the creator's own tank. Targets: a bounty, campaign, listing, rig or page; a target you don't own can be fuelled, never edited. Attribution: rokha.ai/?r=<handle>&p=<party>; distinct others only; the creator's outcomes never count. Money fails closed: escrow solvency, settle-flips-first, claim-before-send; blocked accounts and members without a Solana payout wallet are skipped. Full reference: https://rokha.ai/llms-full.txt. CREATE: the caller must be a Network Member (their USDC pot is pulled from their own Signet mandate into the escrow; their fuel pot from their own tank) or the House. A Member's funded party goes live at once; a $0 party is live at once; a House draft starts from the console. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

brief.description: the ask, in plain words (≤ 1000 chars); include the disclosure line for participants

fuel_budget_usd.description: the FUEL work pot in USD value, drawn from YOUR tank by the attached target's attempts (0 = none)

goal.description: custom only: {lane: built|operated|brought|scouted|sold, event: <ledger event>, window?: party|round}

goal_kind.description: the preset the goal is measured by

goal_value.description: the threshold in the preset's unit (e.g. 25 sign-ins)

hook_token.description: one of YOUR webhook trigger tokens (whk_…) to receive party.started / party.progress / party.settled

payout_on_miss.description: what pays if the goal is missed at the deadline (default pro_rata)

pot_usdc.description: the USDC reward pot (0 = recognition only); capped by ROKHA_HUNTING_PARTY_MAX_POT_USDC

target.description: hunt_reports / proven_listings: comma-separated terms or a tag the work must match

target_id.description: the target's id (bounty id, campaign id, listing external_id, rig id, page handle)

title.description: 4–120 chars, what the party is for

tops_up_reward_usdc.description: bounty target only: move this much of the pot onto the bounty's USDC reward at start
